typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

file.description:
The {@link File} object which contains the python class implementation of the
algorithm.

className.description:
The {@link file} may contain many classes as part of its internal implementation detail.
However, there still is a single class which contains the overall logic of the algorithm.
This field defines the name of that python class.

classKwargs.description:
Defines all the named arguments to the `__init__` function of the python class defined
by {@link className}.

actionRequirement.description:
The contents of the {@link file} must be run in a runtime / conda environment appropriate to
the execution requirements of the algorithm. Define the {@link Action.Requirement} in this field.

convertSpec.description: Defines additional metadata for the instantiation of the {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe}.

inheritsFrom.description:
If the class(es) in the python {@link file} either inherit from or employ the use of other
factory implementations, define those dependencies in this field. All the python class names
defined here MUST be instances of {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipeFactory}.

title:
While {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe}s are used to execute the python classes that contain ML algorithm implementations,
there must exist a system to preserve implemented algorithms such that users may reuse said implementations repeatedly.
This Type contains the implementations of all algorithms that are deemed important enough to warrant repeated use.
Every instance represents a unique algorithm and contains all information necessary to instantiate a
{@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe}.
name: ReliabilityMl.CustomPipeFactory
